
So `import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL` can only be `undefined` for one of these reasons, in order of likelihood:

**1. The variable name has no `VITE_` prefix.** You called it `API_BASE_URL` — Vite only ships variables that start with `VITE_` to the client. Anything else stays server-side and is never injected:

```env
# .env — wrong, invisible to the app
API_BASE_URL=https://your-backend

# .env — correct
VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://your-backend
```

Then read it as `import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL`.

**2. You're checking it in the browser console.** `import.meta` doesn't exist there — DevTools throws `Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module`, and a bare `env.API_BASE_URL` is `undefined`. It only exists inside source files that go through Vite. Add a temporary `console.log(import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL)` in a source file and look at the devtools console instead.

**3. The dev server hasn't picked up the file yet.** `.env` is read at server start — add or rename the line, then restart `npm run dev` and confirm it appeared. Also make sure it's in `.env` (or `.env.development` for dev only); `.env.production` will never show up while you're running `vite dev`, and `.env.local`/`.env` must be in the project root.

**4. Dynamic access.** Use the literal path `import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL` (or a plain destructure). Computed keys like `import.meta.env[name]` work in dev but are `undefined` after `vite build`, because Vite only inlines statically referenced keys. And `process.env.API_BASE_URL` is Node-only — it's always `undefined` in the browser.

````markdown
React + Vite SPA, base URL injected from `VITE_API_BASE_URL` (currently

plugs your contract into `src/services/api/backendContract.js`

`VITE_DATA_MODE=mock|api` switch lets us keep the demo running while your
endpoints land, one group at a time.

Already integrated and working:
- `POST /api/Auth/register/patient` → 200
  `{"message","userId","patientId","email","role"}`
- `POST /api/Auth/login` → 200
  `{"message","accessToken","userId","email","role"}`
- Validation errors → 400 ValidationProblemDetails
  `{"errors":{"FullName":[…],"Email":[…],"Password":[…]}}` — mapped to form fields.
- CORS: preflight returns `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` ✔

## 1. Auth — finish what's started

1. **`POST /api/Auth/login` response** — add:
   - `fullName` (the dashboard shows the user's name; today only `email`

   - `patientId` as a **string** (frontend keys everything by it)
   - `role` in lowercase (`patient` | `center` | `physiotherapist` | `admin`)
   - `expiresIn` or `expiresAt`, plus `refreshToken` if you use one
   - For centers/therapists: `centerId` (and `therapistId` for staff), so the
     same login endpoint can route each role to its portal.
2. **`POST /api/Auth/logout`** — revoke the presented token server-side.
   The frontend already calls logout on sign-out.
3. **Refresh** — the current JWT lives ~1 hour (exp ≈ iat + 3600). Give us
   either `POST /api/Auth/refresh {refreshToken} → {accessToken,…}` or a long
   lived token with a documented idle timeout. Tell us which, and whether a
   401 means "expired, refresh" or "signed out, redirect to login".
4. **`POST /api/Auth/change-password`** `{currentPassword,newPassword}` —
   the patient Settings page has the form but the call is currently disabled.
5. Confirm the auth header: the frontend will send
   `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every non-public endpoint —
   say if you expect a different scheme (`X-Access-Token`, cookie, …).

## 2. Error contract (one shape for all endpoints)

- **Validation**: 400 + `errors` object keyed by the C# property names —

  these to form fields; please keep the keys.

  400 with only `message`, so the form can't attach the error to the Email
  field. Return **409** with
  `{"code":"duplicate_email","message":"…","errors":{"Email":["…"]}}` instead.
- **Bad credentials**: 401 with **no** `errors` object (we render
  "email or password is incorrect" from that condition).
- **Rate limiting**: 429 + `Retry-After`.
- **Server faults**: 5xx with no sensitive details.
- Add a stable machine-readable `code` to every non-validation error body
  (`unauthenticated`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `rate_limited`).
- Validate `gender` (enum `male`/`female`, case-insensitive) and
  `phoneNumber` on register — right now both are accepted unvalidated even
  though the form requires them.
````

  const items = adminNavigation.map(([id, icon]) => ({
    id,
    icon,
    label: t(`admin.nav.${id}`) || id,
    to: `/admin/${id}`,
    end: id === 'dashboard',
  }));

  const current = items.find(item => pathname.startsWith(item.to));
  const title = current?.label || (t('admin.dashboard') || 'Admin Dashboard');

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${title} | PhysioGuide Admin`;
  }, [title]);

  const user = {
    name: session?.name || 'Admin',
    avatar: null,
  };

  const results = search.trim()
    ? items.filter(item => item.label.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()))
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="center-layout" dir={dir}>
      <a href="#admin-content" className="center-layout__skip">
        Skip to content
      </a>
      <Navbar
        logoSrc={logo}
        homePath="/admin/dashboard"
        theme={theme}
        menuOpen={open}
        menuId="admin-sidebar"
        onMenuToggle={() => setOpen(value => !value)}
        search={
          <div className="center-layout__search">
            <SearchBar
              value={search}
              onChange={setSearch}
              placeholder={t('center.searchPages') || 'Search pages...'}
              ariaLabel={t('center.searchPages') || 'Search pages...'}
              onSearch={() => {
                if (results[0]) {
                  navigate(results[0].to);
                  setSearch('');
                }
              }}
            />
            {search.trim() && (
              <div className="center-layout__search-results">
                {results.length ? (
                  results.map(item => (
                    <Link key={item.id} to={item.to} onClick={() => setSearch('')}>
                      {item.label}
                    </Link>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <p>{t('center.noResults') || 'No results'}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        }
        themeToggle={<ThemeToggle />}
        languageSwitcher={<LanguageSwitcher />}
        quickSettings={<QuickSettings languageSwitcher={<LanguageSwitcher variant="mobile" />} themeToggle={<ThemeToggle />} />}
        profileMenu={({ compact }) => (
          <ProfileMenu
            user={user}
            compact={compact}
            profilePath="/admin/settings"
            labels={{ logout: t('center.logout') || 'Log out', profile: t('admin.settings') || 'Settings' }}
            onRequestLogout={() => setLogout(true)}
          />
        )}
      />
      <div className="center-layout__body">
        <Sidebar
          id="admin-sidebar"
          items={items}
          account={{
            ...user,
            role: 'Super Admin',
          }}
          isOpen={open}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        />
        <div className="center-layout__column">
          <main id="admin-content" className="center-page" tabIndex={-1}>
            <Outlet />
          </main>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Footer description="" />
      {logout && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={t('center.logout') || 'Log Out'}
          description={t('center.logoutHelp') || 'Log out of your account?'}
          onClose={() => setLogout(false)}
          onConfirm={async () => {
            navigate(await signOut(), { replace: true });
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default AdminLayout;

Walking your action for a patient: user lookup → `VerifyPassword` → `IsActive` → (Center/Therapist blocks are skipped) → token issued → `MapRole`. In SQL Server, `BIT` defaults to `0` — if your register endpoint inserts into `Users` without explicitly setting `IsActive = 1`, every patient you register is born inactive and can never log in with a correct password. async function resolveSession() {
```js
  const session = getAuthSnapshot().session || await restoreSession();
  if (!session || session.role !== 'admin') throw new ServiceError('forbidden');
  return session;

export async function callAdmin(method, ...args) {
  try {
    const session = await resolveSession();
    if (!mockEnabled) {
      if (!apiAdapter) throw new ServiceError('unavailable');
      return await apiAdapter.execute(method, session, ...args);
    }
    const operation = adminMockApi[method];
    if (!operation) throw new ServiceError('unavailable');
    return await operation(session, ...args);
  } catch (error) {
    throw normalizeServiceError(error);
  }
}
```
